reader_state.scope: Owned worker physical termination and descendant closure are verified by outer dispatch.

resources.cgroup_scope: Shared cgroup; not candidate incremental use; peak may predate this run.
resources.scope: SELF excludes child CPU; CHILDREN RSS is largest child high-water, not sum.

score_semantics: Stable FP64 log_softmax of observed original FP32 learned-head logits; no clipping.
timing_scope: Per-row packing plus forward only; whole batch includes source/hash/init/BGE/native/cleanup.
